commands:
set -euo pipefail
STAGE=73e5bb7db6ba69da37e37d7ed2627ed472737843
PROD=20f3ab645d4be384a6f20073330f2744694b7c4b
cd "$HOME/local-agent"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PROD"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
git fetch --quiet origin v4.13.0-staging
test "$(git rev-parse origin/v4.13.0-staging)" = "$STAGE"
WT=/tmp/local-agent-v413-final
git worktree prune
rm -rf "$WT"
git worktree add --force --quiet --detach "$WT" "$STAGE"
cd "$WT"
echo VALIDATING=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
python3 -m py_compile agentd.py agent_config.py agent_core.py agent_runtime.py agent_process.py agent_repository.py agent_repo_worker.py agent_multirepo.py agent_parallel.py agent_parallel_worker.py agent_repo_admin.py agent_storage.py agentctl.py agent_version.py
if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check agentd.py agent_config.py agent_core.py agent_runtime.py agent_process.py agent_repository.py agent_repo_worker.py agent_multirepo.py agent_parallel.py agent_parallel_worker.py agent_repo_admin.py agent_storage.py agentctl.py agent_version.py tests; else echo RUFF_NOT_INSTALLED_SKIP_LOCAL_ONLY; fi
node --check chat_bridge/control_protocol.js
node --check chat_bridge/bridge_state.js
node --check chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.js
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/content.js
node --check chat_bridge/popup.js
node chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
python3 -m json.tool chat_bridge/manifest.json >/dev/null
python3 -m json.tool chat_bridge/runtime.example.json >/dev/null
env -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_FDS -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_KEYS_DIGEST python3 -m unittest discover -q
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
echo FINAL_FULL_GATE=PASS SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
cd "$HOME/local-agent"
git worktree remove --force "$WT"
